evidence.locator: scripts/build_underwriting_example.py: analyst-authored inputs; no actual operating records
data/public/progress/annual-facts.json: context only; no operating cohort derived from consolidated accounts

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly renewal cohort; not extracted or inferred from Progress contracts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Contract-level eligibility and revenue reconciliation differ.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed permissible price uplift before capture and incremental churn.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Notice periods, caps or competitor pricing prevent the uplift.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed share of the uplift captured after concessions; not a success probability.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed renewal economics show lower net capture.

assumptions.rationale: Incremental lost revenue relative to the otherwise unchanged counterfactual cohort.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Retention/mix evidence cannot isolate this loss or shows a larger loss.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed genuinely variable servicing cost, including the symmetric cost reduction on lost revenue.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Costs are fixed or cannot adjust with cohort revenue.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative monthly contact population; no actual Progress ticket data.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Ticket scope, seasonality or data quality differs.

assumptions.rationale: Eligible share of constructed contacts.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Safety or complexity exclusions reduce the eligible population.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed successful resolution after recontacts; not raw chatbot containment.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Evaluation or repeat-contact measurement fails.

assumptions.rationale: Twelve net handling minutes per eligible successful contact.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Time study shows shifted work or less net time avoided.

assumptions.rationale: Assumed avoidable vendor cost per hour, not salary converted automatically to savings.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor commitments or minimums prevent expense removal.

assumptions.rationale: Explicit monthly vendor-spend action, capped by avoided work and addressable spend; zero in downside.
assumptions.invalidated_by: No approved contract reduction or spend reduction is available.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed monthly expense pool bounding modeled cost removal.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Reconciled eligible spend is lower.

assumptions.rationale: Constructed existing receivables; no new sales or bad-debt recovery assumed.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Subledger reconciliation, terms or disputes do not support the balance.

assumptions.rationale: Share collected early; incremental cash reverses on the counterfactual collection date.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Balances are uncollectible or would already have been paid.

assumptions.rationale: Temporary implementation expense paid before benefits; scenario-specific overrun included.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Vendor scope or implementation staffing changes.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly platform, QA and vendor fee from kickoff, including delayed/failed benefit months.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Signed fees, usage or QA requirements differ.

assumptions.rationale: Monthly governance and analysis expense from kickoff.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Required operator effort or tooling changes.

assumptions.rationale: Committed shared data foundation expense retained even if all initiatives are excluded.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Commitment can actually be canceled before payment.

assumptions.rationale: Illustrative capitalized implementation outlay; not deducted again in EBITDA.
assumptions.invalidated_by: Accounting review requires expense classification or a different asset amount.
